name: 作物收获手测夹具（DTMAPI）
author: DTMAPI QA
description:
开发者手测夹具。
依赖 DTMAPI，仅用于测试作物容器扫描/收获；乔木盆、草/采集类只用于不支持边界确认，不发布到 Workshop。

localized_description.schinese:
开发者手测夹具。
依赖 DTMAPI，仅用于测试作物容器扫描/收获；乔木盆、草/采集类只用于不支持边界确认，不发布到 Workshop。
localized_description.tchinese:
開發者手測夾具。
依賴 DTMAPI，僅用於測試作物容器掃描/收穫；喬木盆與草/採集類僅用於確認不支援邊界，不發布到 Workshop。
localized_description.english:
Developer manual QA fixture.
Requires DTMAPI and only tests crop-container scan/harvest behavior.
Tree basins, grass, and forage paths are boundary checks only and should not be published to Workshop.
